reasoning: The two attempts are nearly the same fix: event-driven counts, a 27-cell grid index for hover, and dirty-flag text and Adornee writes, and both pass all checks. A edges ahead on behavior: it tracks insertion order so exact-distance ties resolve the way the original GetChildren scan did, and it handles CharacterRemoving. B's report is somewhat stronger (an explicit table of unmeasured results and a profiler label), but correct code that keeps the old behavior counts most, so A wins narrowly.

criteria.note: `onBlockAdded`/`onBlockRemoved` on ChildAdded/ChildRemoved keep `counts` and `totalCount` up to date; the only GetChildren is one pass at startup.

criteria.criterion: Hover lookup independent of block count
criteria.note: `cells` grid index keyed by `Vector3` cell; `findHoveredBlock` checks only the cells between minX..maxX etc., at most 27.
`countsDirty` gates `rebuildCountsText`, `refreshLabel` runs only on count or hover change, and `selectionBox.Adornee` is written only when `hoverChanged`.

Connects events before the startup scan and skips duplicates with `records[child]`, keeps the strict `< HOVER_RADIUS` rule, and uses `record.order` so exact ties still go to the earliest-added block, as GetChildren order did.
No throttling, pooling, or Parallel Luau; the per-frame cost is one raycast plus a few table lookups.

Explains the O(n) GetChildren scans and the allocations behind GC, phrases results as expectations ('should be far below 2.5 ms'), and lists MicroProfiler, phone FPS, and behavior checks; it is a little less explicit than B that nothing was measured.
Changes only the script and the report, the `BlockRecord` type is clear, and all checks pass.
`onChildAdded`/`onChildRemoved` keep `countsByName` and `totalChildren` up to date, with a single startup GetChildren pass and `countedNames` dedup.

criteria.criterion: Hover lookup independent of block count
criteria.note: `blocksByCell` grid index, searched only between `getCell(point - reach)` and `getCell(point + reach)`.
`isTextStale` gates `buildText`, and `Adornee` is written only when `hovered ~= hoveredBlock or name ~= hoveredName`.

Counts, total, and the hover rule are preserved, but exact distance ties are settled by cell iteration order rather than GetChildren order (a rare edge case), and the character filter isn't cleared on removal (harmless).
No throttling or micro-tuning; the debug.profilebegin label is diagnostic only.

Says plainly that the after numbers are 'not measured yet', has a results table with expected values, explains the GetChildren garbage behind GC, and gives same-build before/after, scale test, and phone checks.
Changes only the script and the report, the code is typed and readable, and all checks pass.
